fields.title: Introduction to Go Programming
fields.body: Go is a statically typed compiled language designed at Google. It provides excellent performance, simplicity, and strong concurrency primitives.

fields.title: Concurrency in Go
fields.body: Goroutines and channels are the foundation of Go concurrency. The select statement allows waiting on multiple channel operations.

fields.title: Distributed Systems Patterns
fields.body: Patterns like saga, outbox, and CQRS help build reliable distributed systems. Event sourcing enables full audit trails.

fields.title: Search Engine Internals
fields.body: Inverted indexes map terms to documents. BM25 is a ranking function used by Elasticsearch and Solr to score relevance.

fields.title: Database Query Optimization
fields.body: Index selection, query planning, and statistics maintenance are key to fast SQL queries. Use EXPLAIN ANALYZE to diagnose slow queries.

fields.title: Kubernetes for Go Services
fields.body: Deploying Go applications on Kubernetes requires a Dockerfile, Deployment, Service, and optionally a HorizontalPodAutoscaler.

fields.title: gRPC and Protocol Buffers
fields.body: gRPC uses Protocol Buffers for efficient binary serialization. It supports streaming RPCs and is widely used in microservice communication.

fields.title: Machine Learning with Go
fields.body: Go can call Python ML models via gRPC or HTTP. Libraries like Gorgonia provide native tensor operations for building neural networks.

fields.title: Observability: Metrics, Logs, Traces
fields.body: Prometheus collects metrics, Jaeger provides distributed tracing, and structured logging with zerolog gives full observability.

fields.title: WebAssembly with Go
fields.body: Go can compile to WebAssembly, allowing Go code to run in browsers. TinyGo produces smaller Wasm binaries suitable for embedded use.
